metadata.source: Engine simulation; not real-world outcome frequencies
metadata.note: Deterministic seed 1; no host bots, external events, weather shocks, prize money or human officials. Built-in law runs. Fixed legal orders; exceptions explicitly described per probe. Monetary outputs are model calculations, not researched prices.

fixture.note: Controlled regression inputs, not measured cafe statistics. The 800 sqft/$6000 monthly rent/0.5 foot-traffic fixture and 140-point grid preserve the earlier audit. Pedestrians = pack.market.unitsPerSlotMonth / (30 * pack.extra.footfall.captureRate): an average mature cafe without rivals starts at the old reference monthly demand. No renovation class is assigned, so the pack flat build-out cost applies. The role stress test overrides pedestrians with the largest cafe-door count in data/places.json; the bankruptcy stress test uses the smallest.
